texts.preamble: Ashok Thakur vs State Of Jharkhand on 22 February, 2017 Author: Rongon Mukhopadhyay Bench: Rongon Mukhopadhyay Criminal Revision No. 195 of 2001 In the matter of an application under Sections 397 and 401 of Code of Criminal Procedure --- Gokul Chandra Manjhi S/o Late Jugal Manjhi R/o Village Belunja, Ps Chas (M), District Bokaro ... ... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party --- For the Petitioner : Mr. Rama Kant Tiwari, Advocate For the Opposite Party : Mr. Arun Kumar Pandey, Advocate --- Present: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay --- By Court: 3. It has been stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the entire conviction is based on the evidence of the P.W.1 and P.W.2, who both are interested witnesses.
texts.arguments: 3. It has been stated by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the entire conviction is based on the evidence of the P.W.1 and P.W.2, who both are interested witnesses. He further stated that no independent witnesses has come forward to depose on behalf of the prosecution. He further submits that the licence which was supposed to have expired long back was never seized by the prosecution nor produced before the court below. Learned counsel thus submits that in absence of the licence which is the bone of contention between the prosecution and defence has not been produced or exhibited and therefore, the petitioner deserves to be acquitted. In the alternative, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is facing rigors of prosecution case from 1990 and also remained for some time in custody and therefore, the period of sentence of the petitioner be suitably modified. 5. It appears from the allegation that the complainant along with one Jitesh Kumar Pathak, Licence Supervisor and Jawahar Singh had visited the food grain shop at Belunja wherein they found the petitioner transacting the business. On demand made by the Inspecting Party, a licence was produced by the petitioner which was valid till 31.03.1987 and no renewal licence after the year 1987 was produced by the petitioner.
